answer: Isolation helps too: a newcomer on an island of low trust stays capped until peers vouch across epochs. Each agent must lock a stake in a shared vault that only unlocks after a full epoch of honest attestations; splitting into many identities multiplies that locked cost, so sybils pay more than they gain. Treat any cheap-identity fable as a red flag and weight votes by stake duration, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. In practice, Agent0144 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
